ItemID: NA; Title: Amazon Basics HDMI Cable, 18Gbps High-Speed, 4K@60Hz, 2160p, Ethernet Ready, 10 Foot, Black; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I already have an HDMI cable and do not currently need a longer replacement.
ItemID: NA; Title: SanDisk 32GB 2-Pack Ultra MicroSDHC UHS-I Memory Card (2x32GB) - SDSQUAR-032G-GN6MT; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: These could support more Raspberry Pi projects, but I would skip extra cards this time after my recent memory-card purchase.

ItemID: NA; Title: Amazon Basics HDMI to DVI Adapter Cable, Bi-Directional 1080p, Gold Plated, Black, 3 Feet, 1-Pack; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I have no current need to connect a DVI display.
ItemID: NA; Title: SABRENT 7 Port USB 3.0 HUB + 2 Charging Ports with 12V/4A Power Adapter [Black] (HB-U930); ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The extra connections are appealing, but I would choose the smaller hub this time to keep my desk simpler.
ItemID: NA; Title: WD 2TB Elements Portable HDD, External Hard Drive, USB 3.0 for PC & Mac, Plug and Play Ready - WDBU6Y0020BBK-WESN; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: I would choose this for laptop backups and storage for my project files, provided it works with my setup.

ItemID: NA; Title: Fire TV Stick 4K streaming device with Alexa Voice Remote (includes TV controls) | Dolby Vision; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I am focused on networking and computer accessories right now and have no immediate streaming-device need.
ItemID: NA; Title: 64GB EVO Select Memory Card and Sabrent SuperSpeed 2-Slot USB 3.0 Flash Memory Card Reader; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: More storage could help with Raspberry Pi projects, but I would wait until I need additional capacity or a faster reader.
ItemID: NA; Title: Fire TV Stick with Alexa Voice Remote, streaming media player - Previous Generation; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: This does not support my current desk and networking upgrades, so I would pass.
